MetaCommand.name: AOCS_GYRO_CALIBRATION
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Start (or abort) an on-board gyro bias calibration. The spacecraft averages the attitude filter's observed gyro bias over a quiet arc with the star tracker in the determination loop, then applies the result as a compensation on the gyro measurement path. Refused with a specific code if the preconditions do not hold (0x0A01 AOCS unpowered, 0x0A02 a gyro unit off, 0x0A03 no star-tracker reference, 0x0A04 body rate too high, 0x0A05 already running). Progress is aocs.gyro_cal_progress (0x02CA) and the estimate lands in aocs.gyro_cal_bias_x/y/z (0x02CB-0x02CD). NOTE the description used to read "Reset gyro bias estimate", and that is exactly what the on-board handler did — it zeroed a truth state and returned success without estimating anything.

Argument.name: action
Argument.LongDescription: 0=START a calibration, 1=ABORT the one in progress

Argument.name: duration_s
Argument.LongDescription: Averaging arc length. 0 = the configured default (sensors.gyro.calibration.duration_s, 300 s); other values are clamped to [30, 1800] s

Enumeration.label: SAFE
Enumeration.shortDescription: 1 kbps bootloader lifeline rate (ex-BEACON) - not selectable here

Enumeration.label: LOW
Enumeration.shortDescription: 1.0 W RF - link-margin-limited passes, FDIR power reduction

Enumeration.label: HIGH
Enumeration.shortDescription: 5.0 W RF - ceiling (ttc.yaml pa_max_power_w); ~17 W DC at 30% PAE

MetaCommand.name: TTC_SET_DATA_RATE
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Select a rung of the TM data-rate ladder defined in subsystems/ttc.yaml tm_rate_tiers. Sets data_rate_mode (the COMMANDED tier), which the TTC tick resolves the active tier from, so the commanded tier survives the tick and is authoritative. Three tiers: LOW 16 kbps BPSK conv(7,1/2)+RS — ROUTINE OPERATIONS, and the safe-mode / FDIR fallback; HIGH 128 kbps QPSK RS(255,223) — delayed-telemetry playback and image dumps only; SAFE 1 kbps BPSK conv(7,1/2)+RS — bootloader/contingency lifeline rate (renamed from BEACON, 2026-08c — "beacon" always means the UHF whip transmitter now), entered with TTC_SET_BEACON_MODE, not selectable here. LEGACY ENCODING PRESERVED VERBATIM: rate=0 still means "the low rate" and rate=1 still means "the high rate" — they now select LOW (16 kbps) and HIGH (128 kbps) instead of 1 kbps and 64 kbps, so existing procedures, OBCPs and the FDIR ttc_reduce_power action keep their meaning. Permission rules are enforced by REJECTION with an S1.8 execution failure (error 0x0007), never by silent clamping: HIGH requires a deployed antenna and DOWNLINK/dump mode (TTC_SET_DOWNLINK_MODE), and every tier except SAFE is refused while beacon mode is latched. An unknown tier code gives error 0x0003. There is NO on-board elevation gate (2026-08c): the 10 deg HIGH policy is a GROUND rule — the MCS warns when HIGH is commanded below 10 deg from its own contact geometry, and the planner schedules HIGH dumps above it.

Argument.name: rate
Argument.LongDescription: Tier code: 0=LOW(16 kbps, routine operations), 1=HIGH(128 kbps, dumps only), 255=SAFE(1 kbps, bootloader only). Codes come from tm_rate_tiers[].command_code in subsystems/ttc.yaml.

MetaCommand.name: TTC_SET_TX_POWER
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Select an SSPA operating point. Discrete steps only: the RF output of a solid-state PA is a function of the commanded gain state, baseplate temperature and VSWR, and is not a continuous ground-settable quantity. Unknown codes are REJECTED with S1.8 error 0x0003, never clamped. (The old '2 = 8 W' documentation was never executable: set_tx_power rejects anything above pa_max_power_w = 5.0 W.)

MetaCommand.name: TTC_SET_BEACON_MODE
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Enable/disable beacon MODE — pins the S-band ladder to the SAFE (1 kbps) rung. NOT the UHF beacon transmitter (TTC_BEACON_TX_ON/OFF).

MetaCommand.name: TTC_SET_MODULATION
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Set modulation scheme. Changes symbol mapping and effective data rate. BPSK is the default safe mode. Higher-order schemes increase throughput but require better Eb/N0.

Argument.name: mode
Argument.LongDescription: 0=BPSK (1 bit/sym, most robust), 1=QPSK (2 bit/sym), 2=8PSK (3 bit/sym, needs +3.6 dB), 3=OQPSK (2 bit/sym, offset timing)

MetaCommand.name: TTC_SET_DOWNLINK_MODE
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Enter or leave DOWNLINK / payload-dump mode. This is the gate on the HIGH tier of the TM data-rate ladder (TTC_SET_DATA_RATE): bulk downlink has to be entered deliberately, so an S13 image dump or an S15 delayed- telemetry playback is a planned pass activity rather than something the spacecraft drifts into at 1 Mbps. Leaving DOWNLINK mode does NOT clear the commanded tier — the active tier simply falls back to LOW until DOWNLINK mode is re-entered.

MetaCommand.name: PAYLOAD_SET_MODE
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Set payload mode. Modes 1 (STANDBY), 2 (IMAGING) and 3 (CALIBRATION) all request the FPA cooler; mode 0 releases it. The request now drives BOTH the TCS cooler flag and the EPS `fpa_cooler` power line (2026-08b PL-a) — previously this path set a flag against a dark line and the detector never cooled, so FPA READY (0x0610) stayed NO forever with no error.

MetaCommand.name: PAYLOAD_SET_SCENE
MetaCommand.LongDescription: DEPRECATED — pre-set the next scene id. Superseded by PAYLOAD_CAPTURE's own scene_id argument, which overrides this value at capture time; retained for backward compatibility only.

MetaCommand.name: PAYLOAD_CAPTURE
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Trigger one image acquisition. The WHERE is set by the WHEN: schedule this TC with S11.4 at the target overpass. Geolocation is stamped on board from the propagated sub-satellite point at shutter open and returned in the image catalogue — it is not an argument.

Argument.name: scene_id
Argument.LongDescription: Ground-assigned product identifier, later used by PAYLOAD_DOWNLOAD_IMAGE (29) and PAYLOAD_DELETE_IMAGE (30). 0x0000 = let the payload auto-assign the next free id.

Argument.name: lines
Argument.LongDescription: Along-track detector lines. Acquisition time = lines / line_rate_hz (500 Hz, subsystems/payload.yaml). Raw frame volume scales as (lines/2048) x (active_bands/4) x image_size_mb; 2048 lines x 4 bands = 4.0 MB = subsystems/payload.yaml image_size_mb.

MetaCommand.name: PAYLOAD_DOWNLOAD_IMAGE
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Report one stored image product. 2026-08b PL-c: the handler called the model and threw the result away, so no image metadata ever reached the ground on this func. It now answers with a TM(8,2) 20-octet product summary (same layout as PAYLOAD_GET_IMAGE_CATALOG's entries), or an S1.8 refusal if the scene is not in the catalogue.

MetaCommand.name: PAYLOAD_DELETE_IMAGE
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Delete specific image from payload memory

Argument.name: segment_id
Argument.LongDescription: Segment index 0-7 (subsystems/payload.yaml num_memory_segments: 8; the model rejects >= 8. The old '0-79' documentation was never executable).

MetaCommand.name: PAYLOAD_GET_IMAGE_CATALOG
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Request the stored image catalogue. 2026-08b PL-c: this now RETURNS something. The handler called the model and discarded the result, so the one command whose entire purpose is to tell the ground what is on board produced no telemetry at all. TM(8,2) reply, built like PROP_GET_STATUS (func 118): shown(2) + held(2) + product_mb x100 (4) + free_mb x100 (4), followed by `shown` 20-octet product summaries of scene_id(2) lat(4, 1e-4 deg) lon(4, 1e-4 deg) size_kb(4) lines(2) quality(1, %) status(1, 0=OK/1=PARTIAL/2=CORRUPT) flags(1) segment(1). flags bit 0 = the strip was flown on a 3-wheel (degraded) FINE set, bit 1 = a product checksum has been computed. At most 32 summaries per report; `held` is the true count.

Argument.name: mask
Argument.LongDescription: Each enabled band multiplies raw volume by lines x 5000 px x 2 B. Bit order matches SPECTRAL_BANDS[].bit in payload_basic.py. mask = 0x00 is REJECTED (at least one band required).

MetaCommand.name: PAYLOAD_SET_INTEGRATION_TIME
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Set per-band detector integration times. Fixed point, 0.01 ms/LSB (was 4x float32 = 16 argument octets; now 8). Longer integration raises band SNR ~3 dB per doubling.

MetaCommand.name: PAYLOAD_SET_GAIN
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Set detector gain. Fixed point, 0.001x/LSB (was float32). Gain raises reported SNR ~1.5 dB per doubling until saturation.

MetaCommand.name: PAYLOAD_COOLER_SETPOINT
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Set the FPA thermo-electric cooler regulation setpoint (drives the TCS-owned FPA node). Encoded as unsigned CENTI-KELVIN so a negative Celsius value never requires a two's-complement raw: raw = round((T_degC + 273.15) x 100). -15.00 degC -> 25815 = 0x64D7.

Argument.name: setpoint
Argument.LongDescription: FPA regulation setpoint in degC (Peltier-class cooler envelope -20..0 degC, subsystems/payload.yaml). Outside the envelope the TC is REJECTED with S1.8 error 0x0003.

MetaCommand.name: PAYLOAD_START_CALIBRATION
MetaCommand.LongDescription:
Begin a radiometric calibration sequence (dark frame / flat field / both). PRECONDITIONS (2026-08b PL-d — the gate is on the OPTICS, not on a mode word; the old rule was "must be in IMAGING mode", which required the shutter to be open onto the scene before a dark frame could be asked for). Refused with S1.8 unless:
* payload mode is 1 STANDBY or 3 CALIBRATION — never 0 OFF and never 2 IMAGING (error 0x0024); * the FPA is thermally ready, 0x0610 == 1 (0x0025) — dark current roughly doubles every 6-8 K, so coefficients taken off setpoint describe a different detector; * DARK and BOTH: shutter CLOSED, 0x063C == 0 (0x0026) and the calibration lamp OFF, 0x0615 == 0 (0x0027); * FLAT: shutter OPEN and lamp ON; * the devices involved are powered — FPA 0x0600, shutter 0x0603, and the lamp 0x0602 for FLAT/BOTH (0x0007).
A BOTH run starts in the dark configuration and the on-board sequencer opens the shutter and lights the lamp itself at the DARK -> FLAT transition; no ground step can land between two phases 15 s apart. Changing the optics under a running sequence ABORTS it (event 0x0612, reason at 0x0645) rather than completing over invalid frames. Completion sets the per-band coefficients; 0x0646 cal_valid_mask marks the bands that now have BOTH a bias and a gain, so a DARK run completes an earlier FLAT run and vice versa.

MetaCommand.name: PAYLOAD_SET_COMPRESSION
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Select compression algorithm and ratio override (was a single float32 ratio; the algorithm octet was previously unreachable over the wire).

MetaCommand.name: PAYLOAD_SELECT_FILTER
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Rotate the filter wheel to a position (2 s per 90 deg step)

MetaCommand.name: PAYLOAD_CYCLE_SHUTTER
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Run a shutter mechanism EXERCISE. This is a mechanism health test, not a way to reach a position — use PAYLOAD_SET_SHUTTER (func 119) for that. 2026-08b PL-d: `cycles` counts TRANSITIONS of the blade, one per model tick, and the mechanism is driven entirely by the model. Previously the command handler toggled once AND the tick toggled once per remaining count, so cycles=1 moved the blade twice, the shutter always ended where it started, and the shutter could never be commanded closed at all.

Argument.name: cycles
Argument.LongDescription: Number of blade transitions (1-100). An ODD count ends on the opposite position from the start; an EVEN count returns to it.

MetaCommand.name: PAYLOAD_INITIATE_TRANSFER
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Start the on-board image transfer engine for a stored scene — the bridge to the S13_CREATE_TRANSFER ground workflow (textbook section 6.7). 2026-08b PL-c: raises event 0x0610 TRANSFER_START (promised by a source comment and previously emitted by nothing) and answers with a TM(8,2) report of scene_id(2) + bytes_total(4) + blocks(4) + crc32(4) — the three numbers the ground needs to plan and verify a dump, all of which used to be computed on board and then dropped. The transfer drains at the ACTIVE TM information rate (0x0506) and only while the downlink is up (0x0501), not at the old hard-coded 10 Mbps: it stalls at loss of signal and resumes on the next pass.

MetaCommand.name: PAYLOAD_CAL_LAMP
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Calibration lamp on/off (also reachable as S2 device 0x0602)

Parameter.name: prop_thrust_est
Parameter.LongDescription: Thrust estimate at current feed pressure incl. degradation (330 BOL -> 140 EOL); physical thrust only while FIRING

Parameter.name: prop_isp_est
Parameter.LongDescription: Live specific impulse Isp(P) (220 BOL -> 196 EOL)

Parameter.name: prop_dv_remaining
Parameter.LongDescription: Tsiolkovsky remaining delta-V on live propellant (CTG-028 usable envelope)

Parameter.name: prop_burn_dv_achieved
Parameter.LongDescription: Achieved delta-V, last burn (post-burn OD cross-check)

Parameter.name: prop_burn_time_cmd
Parameter.LongDescription: Predicted burn duration at current tank state

Parameter.name: prop_arm_inhibit_mask
Parameter.LongDescription: Bitmask of interlocks blocking arm: b0 catbed, b1 tank P, b2 propellant, b3 AOCS mode, b4 att err, b5 SoC, b6 phase, b7 eclipse, b8 valves, b9 inhibit latched, b10 no burn loaded

Parameter.name: prop_leak_rate
Parameter.LongDescription: Propellant leak rate (0 nominal; the 0x0B01 delta monitor sees a leak first)

Parameter.name: prop_thrust_offset_torque
Parameter.LongDescription: Thrust-misalignment disturbance torque fed to AOCS (1650 uNm at BOL thrust)

Parameter.name: prop_sc_mass
Parameter.LongDescription: Spacecraft mass m_dry + m_prop (12.40 BOL -> 12.00 dry)

Parameter.name: prop_orbit_epoch_version
Parameter.LongDescription: Orbit element-set version — increments per applied burn (planner/MCS cache key)

Parameter.name: prop_sma_km
Parameter.LongDescription: Semi-major axis from the active (post-burn) element set

Parameter.name: prop_power_draw
Parameter.LongDescription: Live propulsion power draw (valves while armed/firing + catbed heater) — the EPS prop line bills this

Enumeration.label: DV_CUTOFF
Enumeration.shortDescription: Closed-loop dv cut-off (accelerometer-integrated within this burn only)

MetaCommand.name: PROP_SET_BURN
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Load a manoeuvre: delta-V magnitude, direction and cut-off mode. The sim publishes the predicted burn duration (0x0B10) for FDS cross-check before arming. Must precede PROP_ARM by <= 300 s.

Argument.name: dv_m_s
Argument.LongDescription: Delta-V magnitude, m/s (0 < dv <= 20; checked against 0x0B0C remaining)

Argument.name: direction
Argument.LongDescription: 0=prograde (+X body, nominal nadir attitude), 1=retrograde (requires 180-deg yaw / INERTIAL hold)

Argument.name: mode
Argument.LongDescription: 0=open-loop timed, 1=closed-loop dv cut-off (accelerometer-integrated within this burn only)

Argument.name: t_start_cuc
Argument.LongDescription: Burn start CUC (0 = fire on PROP_EXECUTE; normally S11 time-tagged per NOM-004)

MetaCommand.name: PROP_ARM
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Arm the propulsion system (two-step: requires PROP_SET_BURN within 300 s and the arm code). Runs all interlocks — catbed >= 180 C, tank pressure band, propellant, AOCS mode/att error, SoC, phase, eclipse, valves; each failure returns a distinct S1(8) code and its bit in 0x0B15.

Argument.name: arm_code
Argument.LongDescription: Fixed arm code 0xA5C3 (= 42435); any other value is rejected

MetaCommand.name: PROP_DISARM
MetaCommand.LongDescription: ARMED -> SAFED; closes the flow-control valve, leaves latch valves

MetaCommand.name: PROP_EXECUTE
MetaCommand.LongDescription: ARMED -> FIRING. Rejected (S1.8) when not ARMED. Normally delivered by the S11 time-tagged schedule (NOM-004 step 3).

MetaCommand.name: PROP_ABORT
MetaCommand.LongDescription: FIRING -> SAFED immediately; closes the FCV and latches abort_reason (0x0B14). Partial delta-V already delivered still perturbs the orbit.

MetaCommand.name: PROP_ISO_CLOSE
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Close latch-valve branch(es) — CTG-028 step 2 isolates 'both branches' (branch=2)

MetaCommand.name: PROP_SET_LIMITS
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Reconfigure the on-board burn-abort thresholds (also the FDIR configuration hook)

Argument.name: att_err_max_deg
Argument.LongDescription: Abort when 0x0217 exceeds this during a burn (default 2.0)

MetaCommand.name: PROP_INHIBIT_SET
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Ground-latched propulsion inhibit (the deployer 'independent inhibits' lesson)

MetaCommand.name: PROP_INHIBIT_CLR
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Clear both the ground inhibit and an FDIR/double-abort latched inhibit (INHIBIT(3) -> SAFED)

MetaCommand.name: PROP_GET_STATUS
MetaCommand.LongDescription: On-demand propulsion status report -> TM(8,2): state, tank pressure, propellant, catbed, dv remaining, inhibit mask, abort reason

Parameter.name: sat_mode
Parameter.LongDescription: Derived spacecraft mode — identical to sc_mode (0=SAFE, 1=NOMINAL, 2=SCIENCE, 3=EMERGENCY)

Enumeration.label: CLOSED
Enumeration.shortDescription: Blade across the aperture — the dark-frame configuration

Enumeration.label: OPEN
Enumeration.shortDescription: Light path open — required for capture and for flat fields

Enumeration.label: BOOTLOADER_OPS
Enumeration.shortDescription: OBC in bootloader, beacon HK only (backwards only, requires FORCE)

Enumeration.label: NOMINAL
Enumeration.shortDescription: Declared operational — unlocks sc_mode NOMINAL and the propulsion interlock

MetaCommand.name: S2_AOCS_MAGNETOMETER
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Control the magnetometer (single 3-axis unit, device 0x0209 — no redundant unit is fitted)

MetaCommand.name: EVENT_ENABLE
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Enable event report generation for specified event IDs

MetaCommand.name: EVENT_DISABLE
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Disable event report generation for specified event IDs

MetaCommand.name: MEM_LOAD
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Load data to on-board memory. Address must lie in an rw region of configs/eosat1/memory/memory_map.yaml; unmapped -> S1.8 code 0x0001, read-only -> 0x0002.

MetaCommand.name: AOCS_SET_TORQUE_GAIN_X
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Set AOCS X-axis torque control gain

MetaCommand.name: AOCS_SET_TORQUE_GAIN_Y
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Set AOCS Y-axis torque control gain

MetaCommand.name: AOCS_SET_TORQUE_GAIN_Z
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Set AOCS Z-axis torque control gain

MetaCommand.name: AOCS_SET_TORQUE_GAINS_ALL
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Set all three AOCS torque control gains

MetaCommand.name: AOCS_DUMP_TORQUE_GAINS
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Dump all three AOCS torque control gains

MetaCommand.name: AOCS_SET_DESAT_INHIBIT
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Inhibit/allow momentum desaturation. A dump drops fine pointing, so it must not pre-empt an imaging strip; the inhibit is also asserted AUTOMATICALLY while payload.mode is IMAGING

MetaCommand.name: PAYLOAD_SET_SHUTTER
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Drive the shutter to an ABSOLUTE position. 2026-08b PL-d: there was no absolute shutter command anywhere in this catalogue — PAYLOAD_CYCLE_SHUTTER was the only shutter TC, and a relative toggle cannot reach a KNOWN state. That is what COM-011 step 2 ("cycle to CLOSED, verify 0x063C == 0 within 10 s") needs, what a dark frame needs, and what PAYLOAD_CAPTURE now checks before acquiring. Idempotent: commanding CLOSED twice leaves it CLOSED. Refused (0x0007) when the shutter mechanism device 0x0603 is unpowered, and (0x0005) while a PAYLOAD_CYCLE_SHUTTER exercise is running.

MetaCommand.name: TTC_BEACON_TX_ON
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Switch the UHF bootloader beacon TRANSMITTER on. This is the second radio, not a mode of the S-band transponder: separate band (437.5 MHz, in the 435-438 MHz amateur-satellite segment), separate PA (1 W RF), separate deployable dipole and separate link budget. It carries HK SID 11 only, and it keeps carrying it when the S-band prime chain is dead - PA off, ttc_tx line pulled, transponder failed or patch stowed. That independence is the entire reason a spacecraft carries one.

MetaCommand.name: TTC_BEACON_TX_OFF
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Switch the UHF bootloader beacon transmitter off. CAUTION: this removes the mission's last independent downlink. With the beacon off, an S-band failure leaves the spacecraft unable to tell the ground that the OBC is alive, and recovery depends entirely on the uplink still working. Use only for RFI de-confliction or a deliberate radio-silence exercise.

MetaCommand.name: MON_ADD_DEF
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Add parameter monitoring definition (mon_id addresses the definition, not the parameter)

Argument.name: check_type
Argument.LongDescription: 0=absolute (value in band), 1=delta (change since last check in band)

MetaCommand.name: MON_ENABLE_DEF
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Enable ONE monitoring definition (12,1 enables the whole service)

MetaCommand.name: MON_DISABLE_DEF
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Disable ONE monitoring definition (12,2 disables the whole service)

MetaCommand.name: S13_CREATE_TRANSFER
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Create a download transfer session for a STORED image product. 2026-08b PL-c: the session is now bound to a real catalogue entry. A scene that is not in the payload's image catalogue is REFUSED (S1.8 error 0x0003 plus a TM(13,4) NAK) — previously a transfer for scene 9999 against an EMPTY catalogue returned transfer_id 1, 4 MB and ACTIVE, so the ground could open, run and complete the download of an image that had never been taken. Use PAYLOAD_GET_IMAGE_CATALOG (S8 func 32) to see what is actually on board. The session is sized from the product's own COMPRESSED size, so `size_mb` is now advisory: it is ignored whenever the scene is catalogued. TM(13,2) response: transfer_id(2) + total_blocks(4) + crc32(4). The last two fields are appended, so a decoder that reads only the transfer id is unaffected; `crc32` is the checksum the instrument computed over the product at capture, and the ground should recompute it over the received blocks — a CORRUPT product (catalogue status 2) will not match, which is how a corrupted image is now diagnosable.

Argument.name: scene_id
Argument.LongDescription: Scene ID to download (must be in the payload image catalogue)

Argument.name: size_mb
Argument.LongDescription: Advisory only; ignored for a catalogued scene. 0 = configured payload image size (4 MB)

MetaCommand.name: S13_DOWNLOAD_SEGMENT
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Request one 1024-byte segment of image data. The bytes are DERIVED from the product (a keyed stream over the catalogue entry's data_seed), so the same segment requested twice is identical and the whole product checksums to the crc32 that S13_CREATE_TRANSFER reported. They used to be a `(segment_num + i) % 256` ramp identical for every scene.

MetaCommand.name: S13_END_TRANSFER
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Complete transfer session and free resources. 2026-08b PL-c: it now really does free them — a session whose blocks were ALL sent deletes the product and returns its storage (event 0x0614, 0x0647/0x0648 fall). Previously nothing was freed, so a spacecraft could downlink its entire store and still report it full. A partial or aborted session leaves the product on board, which is the "the pass dropped, re-dump next orbit" case this service exists for.

MetaCommand.name: DUMP_STORE
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Dump contents of onboard TM store

MetaCommand.name: DELETE_STORE
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Delete contents of onboard TM store

MetaCommand.name: CONNECTION_TEST
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Send connection test, expect S17.2 response

MetaCommand.name: OBCP_LOAD
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Direct-load an OBCP (raw serialized blob: proc_id + name + steps; see docs/OBCP_GUIDE.md)

MetaCommand.name: OBCP_DELETE
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Delete a loaded on-board control procedure (aborts it if running)

MetaCommand.name: OBCP_START
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Activate (start) a loaded on-board control procedure

MetaCommand.name: OBCP_STOP
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Stop (abort) a running on-board control procedure

Argument.name: proc_id
Argument.LongDescription: Procedure ID (0 = stop ALL running procedures)

MetaCommand.name: OBCP_STATUS_REPORT
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Request OBCP status report — TM(18,7) lists every loaded procedure with run state and current step

MetaCommand.name: EA_ADD
MetaCommand.LongDescription: Add event-action definition (trigger_kind 0=S5 event id, 1=S12 monitored parameter id)

Argument.name: trigger_id
Argument.LongDescription: Triggering event ID or parameter ID, per trigger_kind

Argument.name: action_func_id
Argument.LongDescription: S8 function dispatched when the rule fires

MetaCommand.name: SYS_SET_MISSION_PHASE
MetaCommand.LongDescription:
Declare the mission phase. Nothing else advances the phase past 4 (LEOP): the on-board state machine only implements the automatic power-up chain 1->2->3->4 and the reboot revert to 3, so COMMISSIONING (5) and NOMINAL (6) are ground declarations and this is the telecommand that makes them. WHAT THE PHASE ACTUALLY GATES — the phase is not a label, it is a live interlock on six mechanisms: * which subsystems tick at all (phases 0-1 tick nothing); * telecommand acceptance — at phase <= 3 the OBC is running the bootloader and only the bootloader command subset is accepted (S17.1, S9.1, S3 beacon HK, S20.1/3, S8.1 funcs 19/20/52-57/61/ 66/67/69, and this command); * the derived spacecraft mode — sc_mode (and its telemetered copy sat.mode 0x0001) is forced to SAFE at any phase < 6, so the console header cannot read NOMINAL until this command has been sent; * arming of the advanced fault-propagation model, which is disarmed below phase 6 because during LEOP the wheels are legitimately unpowered; * the phase-gated legacy FDIR rules (fdir.yaml `min_phase`); * the propulsion interlock — prop.yaml declares `min_phase: 6`, so with the phase stuck at 4 no burn can ever be armed.
GUARDS. Out-of-range (> 6) is refused with 0x0C01. Phases 0-2 are pre-separation states owned by the launch vehicle and are never ground-commandable, forced or not (0x0C02) — commanding phase 0 would stop the subsystem ticks that carry the uplink and lock the operator out. Entering an application phase (>= 4) while the OBC is running the bootloader is refused with 0x0C03; boot the application first with OBC_BOOT_APP (func 55) and the state machine advances 3->4 by itself. A BACKWARDS transition is refused with 0x0C04 unless the FORCE flag is set: a real mission does not casually go NOMINAL -> LEOP, but an operator rehearsing a regression or unwinding a premature declaration must be able to, so the answer is reject-with-reason plus an explicit opt-in, not a blanket refusal. Every accepted change raises the S5 event MISSION_PHASE_CHANGED (0x0055) carrying the from and to phases.

Argument.name: phase
Argument.LongDescription: Target mission phase. 3-6 only; 0-2 are pre-separation states and are always refused.

Argument.name: flags
Argument.LongDescription: Bit 0 = FORCE (permit a backwards transition). Bits 1-7 reserved, must be 0.
